samples.question: The triangle shows the factual run; dark means ON. Each lower cell applies its row rule to the touching pair above. First flip the red-ringed TOP cell and rebuild, recording the new value of every lettered mediator. Then restore TOP as shown. Test one card in a fresh run: when each listed letter is reached, replace its value by the value recorded from the red-flipped run, then continue downward. Which card recreates the red-flipped bottom row? Answer card-1, card-2, card-3, or card-4.
